zones.reason: Partly a causeway, but the stretch between Checkpost and the MRTS approach sags close to a metre below surrounding grade — overland flow from both sides converges on the corridor.
Broad corridor on compacted fill, though the southern half grades into marsh-fringe levels as it approaches the Pallikaranai boundary.
Sits on the rising Taramani interface; sheet flow sheds quickly back toward Velachery Main Road rather than ponding locally.
Dense residential layout over the old tank-bed fringe; plinth levels sit barely above the seasonal water table and infiltration is minimal.
Gentle slope drains toward Gandhi Nagar, but outlet inlets are few and historically silt up early in the season.
Flat residential grid that funnels into the Surya Nagar pocket; it receives flow from Baby Nagar and Vijayanagar at once.
Reclaimed plot layouts just above marsh level; the only stormwater exit is the Dhandeeswaram trunk, which backs up quickly.
Classic low pocket on the old Dhandeeswaram tank bed — water arriving from three surrounding ridges converges here before reaching the marsh outfall.
Marsh-fringe road at the catchment floor; a high water table late in the monsoon reduces effective infiltration and pipe discharge to near zero.
Sits in the convergence zone between the Gandhi Nagar and Dhandeeswaram flows; residents report knee-deep accumulation within an hour of intense bursts.
Western marsh fringe; long overland flow paths from 100 Feet Road arrive here with no intermediate relief or intermediate storage.
Narrow pocket east of Dhandeeswaram with a single street outlet that surcharges whenever the trunk backs up.
Drains west toward the 100 Feet Road system, but connecting invert levels sit close to the marsh water table late in the season.
Old market core on a slight rise; runoff concentrates at the Checkpost mouth where three corridors and their drains meet.
Northern layout on the Guindy-side ridge; sheds water quickly toward the Main Road sag rather than holding it.
Runs along a gentle ridge shoulder that separates the Baby Nagar and Main Road catchments; rarely ponds itself but exports flow fast.
Lake-edge road; levels fall away sharply toward the water, but effective outfall depends on lake stage, which rises with every monsoon spell.
